fixed_elements: Camera and light-gray backdrop; torso/tail for wave, root for plant, support frame/hooks for swing.
source_acceptance: Existing project identity art only. Prior source-warp object animation rejected; no rejected motion is accepted by reuse of its identity source.
reuse_gap: Source has no complete generated action with demonstrated identity/axis/seam compliance. Existing wave keys additionally supply an owned driver/control baseline.

motion_tolerances.swing_required_axis: Fore-and-aft pitch, changing visible surfaces; no lateral-only movement
motion_tolerances.identity_contact_topology: Must remain visually intact across every transition; no averaging hard defects into a score

interruptions_events: Not applicable: offline footage, no game state or rewards.
